chapter: From bassist to George Shearing's road manager
title: The Apollo Theater package with Belafonte and Ruth Brown
summary: The Apollo bill had Harry Belafonte, Ruth Brown, Pot, Pan and Skillet, and George Hudson's band.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: At the Apollo – was Shearing at the Apollo?
Yeah. We worked together at the Apollo Theater.
Was there anything experiencing what was . . .?

We worked together at the Apollo Theater. This was a very interesting lineup. The lineup was Harry Belafonte, Ruth Brown, and the band was the band from Kansas City – I don’t remember the bandleader at that time, but he was a popular bandleader that traveled with a – he had one of these traveling bands. It was like an r-and-b band. And the Shearing quintet. We played the Apollo Theater with that package. The singers – the male singer was Harry Belafonte. The female was Ruth Brown. Can you imagine where these people went from there, the different directions that was taken. At that time, that was the package. And the comedy team was Skillet. You would never have heard of these people. They were blackface comedians. That’s how far back this goes. They were on the bill. That was the standard setup for the Apollo Theater at that time. It was a group which had – Pot, Pan, and Skillet. That was the name of it. There was an
acrobatic group, did some acrobatics. And of course George Shearing, and, as I said, Harry Belafonte and Ruth Brown. The other group was a big band led by George Hudson from Texas.
